# SiteVue AI

> SiteVue AI puts cameras with real-time AI video analysis on plant floors, lines and job sites. It turns the video into cycle times, labor hours, throughput, quality checks and near-miss alerts by station, crew and shift, with the footage behind every number. SiteVue installs in days, with no software integration required, and runs independently of the customer's IT systems.

SiteVue has pages for industrial manufacturing, automotive, meat and poultry processing, aerospace and defense, consumer packaged goods, medical device assembly, data center construction, and warehousing. Each page has a scroll-driven 3D tour of that floor. The figures in the tours and dashboard mock-ups are sample data.

In poultry plants, SiteVue checks carcasses and cuts for visible defects and contamination, grades paws, wings, breasts and thighs hour by hour, tracks yield, line speed, labor and downtime, flags equipment drift, and checks packaging before shipment. It runs in the processing plant. It is not used in grow-out houses, hatcheries or breeder farms, and it does not monitor flock health.

## What SiteVue Does

- Times every cycle at every station from video, against target, takt or standard hours
- Finds bottlenecks, idle time, wait time and handoff delays
- Checks each step against the SOP or work instruction and flags a missed step at the station
- Checks the product: visible defects, labels and cartons, kit completeness, fasteners
- Flags near misses, missing PPE, and people in forklift lanes, lift zones and saw keep-out zones
- Logs clock-in, clock-out and break times from video
- Keeps a timestamped video record of each unit, serial, lot, pallet or kit
- Ranks top performers on measured output and uses their footage to train new hires

## Results

- +3% profit margin growth in 3 months
- 10–20% OEE and efficiency gains
- 5–10% labor hours recovered
- 90%+ near-miss detection
- 80%+ PPE violation reduction

## Deployment

- SiteVue supplies and installs the cameras
- Installs in days, with no software integration required, and runs independently of the customer's IT systems
- No software integration; the hardware connects to one internet location
- Managers are trained on the dashboard in under an hour

## Cameras

Four form factors, each with real-time AI analysis. Mix them to fit each area.

- **Station:** mounted over a line, a machine, a bench or a dock door
- **Hard Hat:** a first-person view from the worker's hard hat
- **Uniform:** clips to a uniform, vest, frock, apron, smock or gown
- **Safety Glasses:** built into standard PPE safety glasses

## Privacy

- No audio is captured
- Video is processed in a closed system, independent of the customer's IT infrastructure
- Worker footage is used for operational metrics only and can be blurred

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://www.sitevue.ai/): How SiteVue works, with a 3D tour of an industrial site, the nine industries, the four cameras and the demo form

- [Poultry Processing](https://www.sitevue.ai/poultry-processing): Defects in first and second processing, packaging checks, line speed, labor and downtime, and hourly paw, wing, breast and thigh grading, with an FAQ on USDA inspection, privacy and billing
- [Aerospace & Defense](https://www.sitevue.ai/aerospace-defense): Actual hours against standard, missing fastener checks, eye-protection alerts and a video record for every serial, from jig load to final inspection
- [Consumer Packaged Goods](https://www.sitevue.ai/consumer-packaged-goods): Output counted at each station, changeovers timed end to end, and labels and cartons checked against the running format
- [Life Sciences & Medical Devices](https://www.sitevue.ai/life-sciences-medical-devices): Each assembly step confirmed, incomplete kits held before sealing, and a video record for every kit and lot
- [Construction](https://www.sitevue.ai/datacenter-construction): Progress against plan, crew time, lift and saw safety, and QA/QC checks across a data center build
- [Warehousing & Logistics](https://www.sitevue.ai/warehouse): Pallet put-away, pick and pack times, replenishment waits and forklift safety, from the dock door to the outbound trailer
- [Full Content (LLM-optimized)](https://www.sitevue.ai/llms-full.txt): The text of every page above
